content.comment_body: Hello, I have [product_name] installed on Windows 7 Pro. After installing [version_no] I get an error: 'Some network environment changes are detected. Restart [product_name] to apply the changes', which prevents program transfer. My previous [version_no] works without issues. Reinstalling did not resolve it. Thanks for any assistance.

Hi, I experienced this issue when disconnecting my PC from [product_name] and reconnecting to another [product_name]. Try running [product_name] as administrator, set a static IP address for your Ethernet adapter, and disable other Ethernet connections (Internet, WLAN, etc.). See if that works.

Hello. Thanks for your suggestions, but I still encounter the same error when reconnecting to another [product_name] and after running [product_name] as admin, assigning a fixed IP, and disabling other Ethernet connections. The problem persists. Appreciate your help.
Hello, could you please share a screenshot of your 'Control Panel > Network and Internet > Network Connections'? There might be special characters in your device names causing issues.
Thanks, here is my network screenshot.
Try exporting your network driver, remove any special characters (such as accented letters), then re-import the modified driver and restart your computer. This could resolve the issue.
Alternatively, you could change your Windows system language to English.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered a recurring network error with [version_no] of [product_name] on Windows that prevents program transfer. While the previous version worked correctly, the update triggers an error about network environment changes. Troubleshooting steps like reinstallation and adjusting network settings did not help. The issue may stem from special characters in device or network adapter names or from system locale settings.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect smooth operation when changing network environments, as well as reliable program transfer with no error prompts after upgrading to newer software versions.
